integrity: The implication is proved by an exact twice-summed fixed-parity recurrence; the converse obstruction is an explicit positive sequence. Finite computation is only an indexing and constant-factor regression check.
scientific_limitations: The converse failure is sequence-theoretic and does not assert realization by a hyperbolic knot. The result addresses only the real part of Aso's complex-volume conjecture.
title: Fixed-parity second differences strictly refine Goda's twisted-Alexander asymptotic
